content: Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ u Sedesiɑsi Yosiɑsin bii kuɑ sinɑ boko Yudɑɔ, Yekoniɑ Yoyɑkimun biin ɑyerɔ.
Sedesiɑsi wi, kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu, kɑ win tɔmbu bɑ ǹ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑri yi swɑɑ dɑki yi Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Yeremi u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ mi.

N deemɑ sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, bɑ ǹ ɡinɑ Yeremi pirisɔm doke. U rɑ dewɑ mi u kĩ, win tɔmbun suunu sɔɔ. Yerɑ sinɑ boko Sedesiɑsi u Yukɑli Selemiɑn bii kɑ Sofoni Mɑɑseyɑn bii wi u sɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃ku kowo ɡɔrɑ win mi, bu kɑ nùn sɔ̃ u bu Gusunɔ ben Yinni kɑnɑ u kɑ bu nɔnu ɡeu mɛɛri.
Sɑɑ yerɑ Bɑbiloniɡibu bɑ Yerusɑlɛmu tɑrusi. Ye bɑ nuɑ mɑ Eɡibiti sunɔn tɑbu kowobu bɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɡii be somiru sisi, yerɑ bɑ yɑrinɑ bɑ doonɑ min di.
Sɑɑ yerɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni u Yeremi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko wi u nun ɡɔrimɑ nɛn mi sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ, wee, Eɡibiti sunɔn tɑbu kowo be bɑ rɑɑ wee bu kɑ nùn somi bɑ ɡɔsirɔ ben temɔ.
Tɛ̃, Bɑbiloniɡii be, bɑ koo mɑɑ wurɑmɑ bu Yerusɑlɛmu wɔri bu ye mwɑ, bu dɔ̃ɔ sɔku.
Yen sɔ̃, ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, bu ku tii nɔni wɔ̃ke bu nɛɛ, Bɑbiloniɡii be, bɑ tondɑ. Adɑmɑ bɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ bɑ ǹ ɡɑm de.
Bɑɑ bɑ̀ n Bɑbilonin tɑbu kowo be kɑmiɑ, kpɑ n tie be bɑ mɛɛrɑ kuɑ, kɑ mɛ, bɑ koo se sɑɑ ben kuu bekuruɡinun di bu wuu ɡe dɔ̃ɔ mɛni.
Bɑ Yeremi kpɛ̃ɛ pirisɔm dirɔ
Sɑnɑm mɛ Bɑbiloniɡibun tɑbu kowo be, bɑ yɑrinɑ bɑ Yerusɑlɛmu deri Eɡibiti sunɔn tɑbu kowo ben sɔ̃,
yerɑ Yeremi u kĩ u yɑri Yerusɑlɛmun di u dɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn temɔ u kɑ win bɑɑ suɑ tubi ye bɑ bɔnu mɔ̀ sɔɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u yɑriɔ u kɔnnɔ turɑ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ, mɑ u deemɑ ben kɔ̃sobun tɔnwero wi bɑ mɔ̀ Yirɛyɑ Selemiɑn bii, Hɑnɑniɑn debubu u yɔ̃ mi. Mɑ u nùn yɔ̃rɑsiɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ tii Bɑbiloniɡibu wɛ̃.
Yerɑ u nɛɛ, ɑɑwo, nɑ ǹ nɛn tii Bɑbiloniɡibu wɛ̃. Adɑmɑ durɔ wi, u ǹ win ɡɑri yi wure. Mɑ u nùn mwɑ u kɑ dɑ wiruɡibun mi.
Yerɑ wiruɡii ben mɔru yɑ seewɑ bɑ nùn mwɑ bɑ so bɑ pirisɔm doke Yonɑtɑm dirɔ wi u sɑ̃ɑ tire yoro. N deemɑ bɑ win dii te ɡɔsiɑwɑ pirisɔm diru.
Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ kɑ nùn pirisɔm doke dirɔ wɔru sɔɔ sere n kɑ tɛ.

Sɔ̃ɔ teeru, sinɑ boko Sedesiɑsi u ɡɔrɑ u nɛɛ, bu Yeremi sokumɑ. Ye u nɑ, mɑ u nùn ɡɑri bikiɑ ɑsiri sɔɔ u nɛɛ, Yeremi, ɑ ɡɑri ɡɛɛ mɔ yi yi wee Yinni Gusunɔn min di ɑ mɑn sɔ̃? Mɑ u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, oo. Yinni Gusunɔ u koo de Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u nun nɔmɑ turi.
Mɑ Yeremi u mɑɑ nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, torɑ terɑ̀ nɑ bɛɛ torɑ wunɛ kɑ wunɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu kɑ sere wunɛn tɔmbu kpuro i kɑ mɑn mwɑ i pirisɔm kpɛ̃ɛ.
Mɑnɑ bɛɛn sɔmɔ be, bɑ wɑ̃ɑ be bɑ bɛɛ ɡɑri sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko kun nun wɔrim wee u sere tem mɛ mwɑ.
Tɛ̃, nɛn yinni sinɑ boko, ɑ mɑn swɑɑ dɑkio kpɑ ɑ nɛn kɑnɑru nɔ, kpɑ ɑ mɑn kuɑ ye nɑ kĩ. A ku mɑɑ de n wurɑ Yonɑtɑm tire yoron diru mi, kpɑ n ku rɑ kɑ ɡbi.

Yerɑ sinɑ boko Sedesiɑsi u woodɑ wɛ̃ u nɛɛ, bu nùn yiiyo pirisɔm dirun yɑɑrɑɔ kpɑ bɑ n dɑ nùn pɛ̃ɛ kuse teeru wɛ̃ bɑɑdommɑ ye wuun pɛ̃ɛ kowobɑ rɑ ko sere wuu nukurun pɛ̃ɛ yu kɑ kpe. Nɡe mɛyɑ u kɑ sinɑ pirisɔm dirun yɑɑrɑ mi.

dɔkɔ kpiriru sɔɔ
